verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents a dedicated 'B2B Edition' offering company accounts, quotes, and custom pricing for wholesale/enterprise buyers alongside standard DTC storefronts, directly matching the story's core asks (customer-specific pricing, quotes, B2B accounts). Missing for 10: explicit detail on volume/tiered pricing rules, net-terms invoicing workflow specifics, and independent/hands-on corroboration of B2B Edition in practice.
